response.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS test WHERE test.ID = p.ID AND test.`U-PRO` = '-' AND test.RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY avg_HCT IS NULL, avg_HCT DESC LIMIT 10;
